name: pooltable
prompt: A full size antique billiards pool table seen from a three-quarter view, heavy dark carved bald-cypress wood frame with thick turned legs, rich dark green felt playing surface, six woven leather pocket nets with brass pocket corners, mother-of-pearl diamond sights on the rails, the felt completely empty: no balls, no cues, no triangle, swamp lodge style.

name: poolcue
prompt: A single straight billiards pool cue stick lying horizontal, long and thin, dark polished wood butt with ebony inlays and a brass joint ring, pale maple shaft, white ferrule and blue chalked leather tip, nothing else.

name: cuerack
prompt: A rustic wall-mounted wooden pool cue rack made of dark carved cypress, holding six upright pool cues, a small shelf at the bottom with blue chalk cubes, swamp lodge style, front view.
